critic.fix_suggestion: Modify the fuselage window geometry by duplicating the existing single row of dots along the vertical axis to create a second, parallel row. Offset this new row vertically by 15% of the total fuselage height to simulate an upper deck. Additionally, introduce a variable spacing parameter for these rows: reduce dot density by 40% in areas where door outlines are added and increase spacing by 20% at the cockpit transition to create realistic structural gaps.

discrepancies.observed: A single continuous line of small dots along the fuselage.
discrepancies.reference: Multiple distinct rows of windows (main deck and upper deck).

discrepancies.observed: No visible window structure on the forward hump area.
discrepancies.reference: A clear row of windows following the curve of the upper deck.

discrepancies.observed: Smooth fuselage surface with no breaks or recessed lines for doors.
discrepancies.reference: Distinct rectangular outlines and seams for main cabin and service doors.

discrepancies.observed: Uniformly spaced dots across the entire length of the fuselage.
discrepancies.reference: Varied spacing with larger gaps around door locations and cockpit area.
